audio.text: Where should I hand in the lab report?

options: Put your lab report in the box outside room 210.
The lab report should be about five pages long.
I handed out the flyers this morning.
Yes, the lab closes at six today.

why.en: "Where" → a place. B gives a length; C repeats "handed" with a different meaning; D answers "Yes" to a "where" question.
why.tr: "Where" → bir yer. B uzunluk söylüyor; C "handed" kelimesini başka anlamda tekrar ediyor; D "where" sorusuna "Yes" diyor.
why.es: "Where" → un lugar. B da una extensión; C repite "handed" con otro sentido; D responde "Yes" a una pregunta con "where".
